evidence.label: GM Bulletin 21-NA-240 - Information on LSY Engine Oil Leaks

after.title: LSY Cam-Carrier T-Joint Oil Leak Can Mimic Other Front-Engine Leaks (21-NA-240)
after.description: GM bulletin 21-NA-240 covers 2020-2024 Cadillac CT5 models with the 2.0L LSY engine. An improper amount of cam-carrier gasket sealant can leak at the T-joint and appear to come from the front cover, lower oil pan or upper timing-chain cover.
after.solution: Clean residual oil, add oil dye and trace powder, and run the engine until the source is observed. Reseal the cam-carrier assembly only when the leak is isolated to the T-joint; otherwise continue normal oil-leak diagnosis.
symptoms: Engine oil leak at the front of the engine
